title: Hermetica, Vol. 1
author: Walter Scott (ed)
description: Walter Scott's edition of Hermetic writings attributed to Hermes Trismegistus. This first volume provides access to philosophical and religious texts concerned with divine mind, creation and the human search for spiritual knowledge.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/ScottHermeticaVolOne).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
